### Harden Not Your Hearts
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/harden-not-your-hearts
Passage: Hebrews 3:7-10
Points:
- The author of Hebrews quotes Psalm 95 to admonish suffering Christians to persevere in their faith.
- By stating that the Holy Spirit actively speaks, Scripture shows God still talks directly to His people today.
- The wilderness generation lost the Promised Land because they grumbled and doubted God despite seeing His works.
- Turning away from Christ is an even more tragic rebellion, because deliverance in Jesus exceeds the Exodus.
- Old Testament narratives provide vital warnings to help modern believers avoid spiritual downfall.

### Guarding Against Unbelief
Author: Alistair Begg
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/truth-for-life/truth-for-life-july-17-2024.html
Passage: Hebrews 3:7-9
Points:
- The Israelites chose their own judgment over God's promises and spent their lives wandering in the wilderness.
- Every believer battles an innate propensity toward doubt and self-directed sinful rebellion.
- Unbelief turns the heart into a hard surface that God's Word cannot penetrate.
- Knowing and defending the Bible is dangerous if our hearts remain closed to what God says.
- Christians need mutual daily encouragement and the Spirit's work to stay soft and receptive to truth.
